DuplicateRule.alertText: Only one Lending Highway request may be submitted per application number. If you are resubmitting your Lending Highway request, please go back to the original record to resubmit; do not create a new request for resubmissions.
DuplicateRule.description: Blocks users from creating Lending Highway requests when the LOS Application Number or the Broker Number matches an existing record on create. Allows, with alerts, when editing the record.
DuplicateRule.masterLabel: Block Duplicate Lending Highway Requests On Create
